C0314.title: DNS DDoS Amplification Attack Detection Using Multi-Layer Perceptron Classification Algorithm
C0314.summary: In July 2024, this IEEE AIC conference paper studied DNS DDoS amplification attack detection using a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) classification algorithm to analyze network traffic and identify abnormal traffic patterns with machine learning. It focuses on attacks that abuse DNS resolvers to amplify small queries into high-volume traffic and cause denial of service; Crossref and OpenAlex metadata verify the paper title, conference, DOI, and abstract.
